_meta.description: Skeleton J1939 database for CSU-RP1210. It defines the schema and contains NO SAE J1939 Digital Annex content. The example entries use the manufacturer-proprietary ranges (PGN 65280 / 0xFF00, SPNs 520192+) and are illustrative only.
replace_with_licensed_copy: Generate a database from your licensed J1939DA spreadsheet, e.g. with pretty_j1939's create_j1939db-json (https://github.com/nmfta-repo/pretty_j1939).
Save it as J1939db.licensed.json next to this file (git-ignored), or set the CSU_J1939DB environment variable, or pass --db to the csu tool.
Replacing this file directly also works, but then git will show it as modified. Do not commit licensed content.

schemas.current: J1939PGNdb[pgn].SPNStartBits lists the start bit of each SPN in SPNs (same order), so one SPN can sit at different positions in different PGNs. Produced by pretty_j1939.
schemas.legacy: J1939SPNdb[spn].StartBit holds one start bit per SPN. Used by the original CSU-RP1210 database. Resolution -2 means ASCII and -3 means binary (raw integer).

_meta.bit_numbering: Start bits are 0-based with bit 0 = least significant bit of data byte 1 (J1939 byte 1 bit 1).
_meta.data_packs: Additional files with the same layout (e.g. OEM proprietary definitions) can be layered on top with csu --pack FILE; later files override earlier ones.
